### Upcrossing Inequality

:::{.theorem data-title="Upcrossing Inequality"}

Let $(X_{n}, \mathcal{F}_{n})$ be a [[martingale-theory|submartingale]], $a<b$,
and $U_{n}(a,b;X)$ be the number of [[upcrossings|upcrossings]] of $[a,b]$ by
$X=(X_{n})$ up to time $n$. Then
$$
\mathbb{E}[U_{n}(a,b;X)]\leq  \frac{1}{b-a} \mathbb{E}[(X_{n}-a)^+].
$$

:::

`\begin{proof}`

`\end{proof}`
